class.name: IfcProtectiveDeviceTrippingUnitType
class.brief_description: The distribution control element type IfcProtectiveDeviceTrippingUnitType defines commonly shared information for occurrences of protective device tripping units. class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Identifies the predefined types of protective device tripping unit types from which the type required may be set. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
